description: This Java source file defines the WiFiChatFragment class, which manages the UI and interactions for a Wi-Fi Direct peer-to-peer chat interface within an Android application. It includes UI components such as message display list, input field, and send button, along with an inner class for message adapter.

classes.name: WiFiChatFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment handling chat UI components and interactions for Wi-Fi Direct chat.

classes.name: ChatMessageAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending ArrayAdapter to display chat messages with different styles for sent and received messages.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes UI elements, and sets up the button click listener for sending messages.

methods.name: setChatManager
methods.description: Sets the ChatManager instance used to handle message transmission.

methods.name: pushMessage
methods.description: Adds a new message to the chat display list and refreshes the UI.
